selection_rule: Every remaining unheld Shell, CMake, Git Config, JSON, YAML, Dockerfile and Makefile record in the fixed cohorts, at all lengths; no substitutions.
findings: Observed roles in this batch: twelve shell scripts, eight authored configurations, two generated build files and two localization files. These are assistant annotations of the selected texts, not corpus-wide proportions or admission decisions.

A DynamoDB setup script ignores its template-path option inside embedded Python; a VM helper captures a background PID before launching the intended process; a service-manager test asserts an earlier listing instead of the new result.
A variant-processing script has an inverted compressed-header branch and early exits that omit saved indels. These are static control-flow observations, not domain-validated biological results.
Cloud scenario completion and script test filenames do not establish independent correctness oracles. External services, fixtures, platform contracts and embedded shell blocks remain unverified.

Generated dependency maps, an installed collection test driver and a library build wrapper require upstream/dependency attribution distinct from host repositories. Paths/version literals alone do not verify lineage.

An image-cache script accepts a matching header filename without checking cached image presence or integrity. The paired Dockerfile and monitoring configuration pairs provide same-repository context, not runtime validation.

boundaries: Full static assistant reading, not independent annotation or behavioral verification. No corpus scripts, tests, shell blocks, configuration commands, builds, containers or cloud actions executed.

All 218 original identities, token counts, language labels and sampling weights retained; all 43 family holds preserved. No automatic language relabeling, role filter, replacement selection or new family hold.
No network requests, eligible yield, training admission, source ranking or GPU work. Exact replay verifies bookkeeping and recorded inputs, not the independence or correctness of semantic judgments.
next: Finish the remaining 76 unheld records in the fixed cohort, then reconcile observed roles, source-use/provenance gaps and finite eligible supply into the existing qualification packet before selecting data-study arms. Do not expand the sampling frame merely to replace unresolved outcomes.
